The six auction facts (round, price basis, official value, round result, bid amount, auction date) are elements of `LegalActionRequest` and `LegalActionUpdate` and facts of the decision record; `legal_action` and `hearing` stay unchanged. The ladder states are stages of `LitigationWorkflow`, and the trigger is an auction signal of `LitigationWorkflow` (GAP-2826). The three consumed owner operations are placeholders until their owners confirm them, and the three consumed reads are built against the owners' documents and fakes from Day 1; their operation names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2827; ASM-4653). The day count of the enforcement task due date is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2827); the four price bases and that day count are held as rule package reference values of `rwb_decision`.

Reference data: the lists read by this contract are `LOV-LEGAL-TYPE` and `LOV-LEGAL-STATUS`; the parameters read are the rule package of `rule_row` and the four price bases, under the reference-data contract of DP-06 and DP-07. No parameter key is declared here; its parameter-catalog key is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S4-E5019-CON-20).

BR Field ID: the eight rows of this section have no BR Field ID, which is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S4-E5019-CON-7). The auction element names are contract element names and are not LDM fields (BR6).
